text:
dave: Quick heads-up: I pushed a small Next.js + LangChain starter that wires LlamaIndex -> Redwood embeddings. Found a confusing UX when SSR persists an index and the edge loader fails to roundtrip the snapshot, causing repeated rebuilds on client nav. Repo: https://git.company/oss/next-llama-quickcheck
iris: ouch. Symptoms? logs?
dave: server persist OK, edge load throws "SnapshotCodecError: unsupported codec v0z" and then rebuilds. users hit extra compute and slow navs.
build-bot: recent trace: kv.get docs-site/snap size=172kb then error at edge load.
kevin: likely SDK serializer/runtime mismatch or caret-pinned deps pulling different patch versions for node vs edge bundles. did you see varying @redwood/inference versions?
dave: yup: local node grabbed @redwood/inference@0.16.0, edge image in CI had 0.15.7.
morgan: two quick mitigations: (1) change starter to explicitly pass serializer on persist/load in examples, (2) make postinstall check warn (not fail) when it can't verify parity (pnpm/monorepo friendly).
iris: +1. Also add a dev-time roundtrip validator that runs on first dev start: persist a tiny index -> load it -> if mismatch, print an actionable message with exact remediation steps (pin version or set serializer). Don't fail the build.
dave: I added a tiny `scripts/runtime-check.js` that does best-effort lockfile inspect and a short roundtrip using an ephemeral in-memory doc. It warns with code pointers instead of exiting. Will attach PR.
kevin: can we also include a small jest e2e harness that simulates SSR persist -> edge load and asserts no rebuild by checking trace spans? Add that to CI for starters so our repos catch regressions but end users aren't blocked.
morgan: good plan. Also propose a small README troubleshooting section (symptoms, logs, fixes) and a short note about token rotation: intermittent 401s during persist can cause fallback writes — recommend server-only index builds and client-side embeds for most apps.
iris: SDK suggestion: when a loader fails due to unknown codec, emit a robust error that includes detected codec, SDK semver, and a help link. File an SDK issue with example logs and link it from the README.
dave: PR will include: (1) explicit serializer examples in code, (2) postinstall -> warn-only behavior, (3) runtime-check dev validator (non-fatal), (4) jest e2e roundtrip test wired into starter CI, (5) README troubleshooting. tagging @iris @morgan for review.
kevin: thanks, this will cut a lot of onboarding confusion. label as medium DX and backport validator to other starters after merge. :thumbsup:
